name: ai.dotsy/mcp
title: dotsy
description: Build and publish static sites on dotsy with draft-first MCP tools, OAuth Connect, and API keys.

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Create empty site; seeds brief. Globally taken slugs auto-suffix to `{slug}-{adjective}-{noun}` (default); pass onSlugTaken:"fail" to get a 409 instead of a renamed site.

editingMode.description: How the editor's Save behaves. 'live' (default) publishes each save; 'staged' keeps drafts until publish_site. Prefer 'staged' when handing the editor to a person (start_edit_session → draftEditorUrl). API writes always stage.

workspace.description: Workspace org id or slug (multi-workspace only; omit if one workspace).

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Site detail, stats, publicUrl, brief head (default-on), and readiness flags. pages[] is a ~25-entry head by default (stats.pages has the true count); pass pages: true for the full array (capped at 1000), or list_content/get_site_manifest. Large sites (200+ pages): list_pages is paginated (cursor) or use get_site_manifest for the full route set.

pages.description: Return the full pages[] array instead of the default ~25-entry head (server-capped at 1000 either way). Default false.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: update_brief
tools.description: Update `_intent/site.md` (site brief) or a page brief when `page` is set. See field descriptions for rules, notes, and head enums.

page.description: Content key — targets that page's brief (`_intent/pages/<key>.md`). Omit for the site brief.

design.description: Site: palette, type, layout only. Page: direction, hero only.

head.description: Head fields to merge; null clears a field. Site: all fields (purpose ≥5 chars). Page: purpose and design only. business: null clears the block, address is replaced whole. Business facts reach live pages at the next publish. Authors are not part of the brief: `authors` answers 400 `authors_moved` — create them as items of the Authors collection (put_post at authors/<slug>.html).

notes.description: Site: free-form ## Notes string (≤4k) OR per-section notes object for Design system / Content & CMS / SEO (null clears one). Page brief: string only (≤2k).

rules.description: Rules & guidelines to add or change (upsert by id; omitted fields keep their value; check: null turns a Rule into a Guideline). A supported check (title-max, title-suffix, description-length, one-h1, banned-words, image-alt, allowed-colors, allowed-fonts) makes a Rule: level block for hard musts, warn for softer. Only a person can set locked; locked: false unlocks.

removeRules.description: Ids of rules or guidelines to remove (site brief only).

appendHandoff.description: Append a hand-off log line — site brief only; ignored when page is set.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Read-only workspace plan and pooled usage; pass slug for this site's add-ons. Call before a large build.

slug.description: Optional site slug — adds a per-site add-ons segment to the summary.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Read-only traffic overview (default) or full breakdowns via include[]; optional bot id for crawler page drill-down.

include.description: Full breakdown sections to add under `detail`: pages, sources, countries, devices, browsers, os, utm, goals, series, crawlers, experiments, events, helpful (all-time "Was this helpful?" yes/no per page) — or 'all'. Omit for the overview only.

bot.description: Crawler bot id (e.g. googlebot, gptbot) → that bot's top crawled pages under `crawlerBotPages`.

tools.name: set_analytics_provider
tools.description: Connect an analytics provider (GA4, Plausible, Fathom, Umami) or remove it (provider 'none'). dotsy adds its script to every live page's <head>, no publish needed. One provider per site. Use this, not a pasted GA4 gtag snippet. Other tags (GTM, ads pixels, Clarity, verification <meta>) go in set_custom_code.

measurementId.description: GA4 only: measurement ID, e.g. G-ABC123XYZ.

loadTiming.description: GA4: immediate counts every visit; after-load is faster but misses visits under ~1 s without interaction. Default: after-load.

domain.description: Plausible only: the site domain registered in Plausible, e.g. example.com.

host.description: Umami only: https origin of your Umami instance.

tools.name: get_custom_code
tools.description: Read the site-wide custom code: `draft` (what the next publish puts live) and `published` (what visitors get now) for both boxes — head (before </head>) and body (before </body>) — plus `pending`, `runOn` and `maxChars`.

tools.name: set_custom_code
tools.description: Set site-wide custom code: `head` goes before </head> and `body` before </body> on every page. Saved as a draft; goes live with the next publish_site (on a live-mode site the dashboard publishes only the code). Never runs in the editor. ≤20,000 characters per box; `warnings` flags likely mistakes (unclosed <script>, <html>/<head>/<body>, canonical or robots tag, GA4 already connected) without rejecting. Send only the boxes you change; "" clears one. `runOn` ('live' default, or 'live-and-preview') applies at once — agents limited to drafts can't set it. For tag managers (GTM), Clarity, ads pixels, chat widgets, verification tags; plain GA4/Plausible/Fathom/Umami: set_analytics_provider.

head.description: Code for before </head> on every page. "" clears it.

body.description: Code for before </body> on every page. "" clears it.

runOn.description: Where it runs: 'live' (live site only) or 'live-and-preview'. Applies at once.

tools.name: set_site_icon
tools.description: Set the favicon from a square image asset. Draft until publish.

tools.name: update_site
tools.description: Update site settings: title, keyConvention, editingMode, signature ("Made with dotsy" badge), trailingSlash, ownSeoFiles, aiTrain, acceptIssues, the language settings, and cookieBanner (draft until publish; get_site shows it). Each field says when it applies. Slug is the hostname — use rename_site.

editingMode.description: live (default): each editor save publishes. staged: drafts wait for publish_site; use it when handing the editor to a person.

enabled.description: Show the badge on every published page.

reveal.description: seal = stamp on hover, pill = label on hover, eye = always open, follows the pointer.

signature.description: "Made with dotsy" badge (defaults: mark dot, reveal seal, side right). Live at once.

trailingSlash.description: ignore (default) serves /blog and /blog/; never 301s /blog/ to /blog; always the reverse. Live at once.

ownSeoFiles.description: Use the site's own robots.txt even if it blocks everything (Disallow: /), and its sitemap.xml instead of the generated one. At the next publish.

aiTrain.description: false asks AI training crawlers not to use the live site (default true). Live at once.

acceptIssues.description: true keeps the remaining SEO/page-health warnings (get_site_tasks hides them); false undoes. Needs verify_page first; ask first.

decline.description: siteState.next.step ids the person declined; all = no more suggestions.

defaultLanguage.description: Main language, e.g. "en". null removes every language setting. At the next publish.

publish.description: false hides it from translation links and the switcher; pages still serve. Default true.

languages.description: The OTHER languages (not the main one); replaces the list. Needs a main language. Applies at publish.

hreflang.description: auto (default) tells search engines which pages are translations of each other; off stops that. At publish.

mode.description: smart asks in the EEA, UK, CH, Québec, unknown country and GPC, elsewhere a notice that sets the cookie and offers Opt out; always asks everyone; off = your own cookie tool.

alsoAskIn.description: Extra places, e.g. ["BR","US-CA"]; replaces the list.

text.description: {headline ≤60, body ≤240 (must name dotsy, the host that sets the cookie), accept, reject, optOut ≤24}; null resets a key.

look.description: {accent (#hex or rgb()), accentText, text, bg, link, font, radius e.g. 8px}; null resets a key.

cookieBanner.description: Send only what changes; null resets a field. Relay `issues` as written; Reject stays a full same-size button.

tools.name: rename_site
tools.description: Rename the site slug (hostname {slug}.dotsy.site). Owner-only; use the returned slug afterwards. Published site: the old slug redirects on the API (301 reads, 308 writes) and the old host 301s, both reserved until delete or rename-back. Never published: the old slug 404s and its hostname is released (create_site can reuse it). Stored HTML URLs are not rewritten (use find_replace).

tools.name: publish_site
tools.description: Publish draft to live. Only when the person asked to publish (not for "clean up"). handoff required; feedback optional. Warnings (form_unwired, store, SEO) are advisory: tell the user. Site-check errors return a publish_issues decision. A request to publish is not agreement to publish those errors: use its publishWithIssues code only after the user has seen them and said to publish anyway; if you can't ask, fix them or stop and report. If a fix needs text or a link target you don't know, ask the user.

feedback.description: Optional session feedback; tool intents are attached automatically.

handoff.description: One sentence: decisions, preferences, or open threads for the next session (appended to the brief).

confirmedDraftFingerprint.description: Required when get_draft_status returned requiredDecision (publish_confirm); the current fingerprint from get_draft_status.

publishWithIssues.description: The publish_issues code (see the tool description). true does not work.

acknowledgeSeoWarnings.description: Only satisfies the brief seo=must block, never publish_issues.

openItems.description: openItems: ignored. The owner's own choice is recorded on their dashboard.

pages.description: Publish only these pages (≤50 route paths, e.g. /pricing) — use when a publish returns rules_not_fully_checked; publish the rest in further batches.

onlyReady.description: Publish only changes marked ready (server hashes); not with pages. Skips the publish_confirm fingerprint.

tools.name: get_site_tasks
tools.description: What needs fixing on a site, from stored checks. Call after writes, before publish_site.

tools.name: get_draft_status
tools.description: Pending draft changes: content keys and routes with status. May include requiredDecision (publish_confirm) before publish_site.

tools.name: review_changes
tools.description: Review queue: what changed and isn't live yet. list (counts first) → get one item (hidden changes, optional diff, bodyChanged: false means only title/meta/route fields changed — review hidden, not the visible page) → mark_ready / unmark (≤50 ids). Then publish_site onlyReady:true. Drafts-only sites: a person marks.

action.description: list (default) · get one item · mark_ready · unmark

id.description: get: item id from list (p:/path, s:key, m:menus)

ids.description: mark_ready / unmark: item ids from list (≤50)

tools.name: discard_drafts
tools.description: Permanently discard unpublished drafts: all (omit key/keys/routes/menus), one key, menus:true (menu draft) or keys/routes. Only when the person asked to discard or undo; "clean up" is not that. First call changes nothing and returns what would be lost plus a confirm; ask the person, then repeat with it.

tools.name: delete_site
tools.description: Permanently delete site; confirmSlug must equal slug.

tools.name: bulk_put_content
tools.description: Stage many content keys (pages, layouts, fragments). Content only — not routes or assets. Each body ≤60KB and the whole call ≤80KB; larger pages use stage_content_chunk, dotsy push, or PUT content-raw. May queue above the inline threshold.

tools.name: get_site_manifest
tools.description: Content keys + hashes only (optional routes=true) — static files live in list_assets, not manifest. Diff keys+hashes before apply_changeset; stage only changed bodies.

tools.name: find_replace
tools.description: Case-insensitive find→replace across pages in one staged commit. Batch all replacements into ONE call — never parallelize find_replace on the same key (concurrent edits surface as per-key conflict). find/replace ≤60KB.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Find pages containing a phrase (grep without reading bodies). Requires do-sqlite — graduate_site first if search_unavailable.

tools.name: graduate_site
tools.description: Enable site search & collections (kv → do-sqlite), one-way. Unlocks search_content, collection indexes, visitor /__paige/search, and moves any R2 form ledger into SiteDb. 409 blocked: `reason` names the gate — unsupported backend (never overridable); strictDrafts (default true) on unpublished drafts or unrecovered KV rows; or an incomplete-looking KV snapshot, the only gate force:true overrides. `audit` = aggregate counts: judge the gap before forcing. Anything outside the frozen snapshot is unreachable afterwards.

strictDrafts.description: Block on unpublished drafts or unrecovered KV content rows (default true — publish/discard first, or pass false to proceed anyway).

force.description: Proceed past the incomplete-KV-snapshot 409 only — not the unsupported-backend or strictDrafts blocks, which force does nothing for. Read the blocked response's `reason` + `audit` first; the flip is one-way, so rows outside the snapshot are unreachable afterwards. Default false.

tools.name: apply_changeset
tools.description: Stage writes[] + deletes[] in one call; attach routes via writes[].route. writes[].ifMatch (hash from get_site_manifest; "" = must not exist) guards each key (a delete takes { key, ifMatch } too); atomic:true makes one stale key write nothing (409 changeset_conflict). At most 10 writes; each body ≤60KB and the call ≤80KB. Larger new pages: stage_content_chunk then writes[].bodyStaging, or dotsy push / PUT content-raw.

contentKey.description: Explicit content key (default: path-derived). null restores the default (undoes a prior set on PATCH).

layout.description: Layout NAME, bare ("default" for layouts/default.html), not the file key. Must already exist (400 layout_not_found). null removes it.

redirectTo.description: Root-relative redirect target (/…). Required when purpose is "redirect"; null clears it once purpose is no longer "redirect".

redirectStatus.description: 301 permanent / 302 or 308 temporary (default 301 on a redirect). null clears an explicit override.

preserveQuery.description: Append the visitor's query string to the redirect target (default true on a redirect). null clears the override.

id.description: Stable experiment slug — cookie namespace; unique per site forever.
Variant arm id — default "a" / "b" on create.

goalId.description: Optional dotsy conversion goal; omit when tracking in external analytics.

changeNote.description: One line on what the variant changes (0.56e M2); kept so route PATCH round-trips don't strip it.

handsOff.description: Hands-off mode (0.56e M4): the daily sweep may auto-promote a ≥95% winner or auto-end keep-A after 30 days. Prefer start_test; kept so route PATCH round-trips don't strip it.

noindex.description: Exclude from sitemap/RSS; inject noindex meta (0.69).

lang.description: Page language, e.g. "es", "pt-BR". null clears (folder or main language applies).

translationKey.description: Pages sharing a key are translations of each other. null clears.

deletes.description: Keys to delete: a key, or { key, ifMatch } (the hash you read) so a page changed since is not deleted (listed in conflicts).

atomic.description: All or nothing: every writes[].ifMatch and deletes[].ifMatch is checked before anything is written. One stale key writes nothing and the call fails with 409 changeset_conflict listing `conflicts`. Default: a stale write is skipped and listed, the rest apply.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: import_site_from_url
tools.description: Import URL to draft. Waits up to ~40 s; if still running it returns the job id, progress, warnings and `next` (get_site_tasks). On complete, the response may include requiredDecision: mirror vs editable, which is worth asking the person after they see the preview and before any structure_* call.

mode.description: Default auto — per-page mirror with silent render escalation

pages.description: Explicit page list; omit to import sourceUrl as index.html

sitemap.description: Sitemap path relative to sourceUrl, e.g. /designs/sitemap.xml. Omit only to import this segment's single hub page — expansion does NOT happen without it, and a segment_hub_only warning is returned as a reminder.

segments.description: Split-origin segments — each expands into pages by fetching its own `sitemap`. A segment without `sitemap` imports only its pathPrefix hub page (with a warning), not the whole prefix.

keyConvention.description: Content key shape: directory = Astro dist (about/index.html); default flat

workspace.description: Workspace org id or slug (multi-workspace only; omit if one workspace).

tools.name: get_structure_status
tools.description: Flat vs structured page counts; chromeCoverage = real per-fragment page counts + missedPages (check before promising sitewide edits). Informs user — do not auto-run analyze/apply while requiredDecision pending.

tools.name: structure_site_analyze
tools.description: Propose shared layout + fragments; persist:false first. Wait for mirror-vs-editable answer if requiredDecision pending.

scope.description: Default flat-only; analyze clusters flat keys only.

persist.description: First call: false (preview only). true only after user confirms editable/CMS mode.

full.description: Return the full manifest incl. per-page HTML samples (default: compacted — etag/action/counts kept, samples truncated — to fit the token budget).

tools.name: structure_site_apply
tools.description: Rewrite flat pages to layout + fragments (draft). Do not call while requiredDecision pending — user must pick editable first. It extracts header/footer only; report chromeCoverage counts, not 'sitewide'. Afterwards share_section with no arguments lists the other repeated blocks (banner, CTA).

ifMatch.description: Manifest etag from structure_site_analyze or get_structure_status.

mode.description: Default apply. Neither value is a dry run — review-only persists the same content/layout write as apply. Only pass review-only after a review_required error (low analyze confidence); it labels the result outcome "review" and defers primary-nav auto-wiring to a later apply call.

restructure.description: Required true when scope all and site has structured pages.

tools.name: get_structure_result
tools.description: Last structure apply job result (structuredKeys, conflicts, partial).

full.description: Return the full manifest/detail (default: compacted for the token budget).

tools.name: adapt_site_analyze
tools.description: Propose nav wiring + blog collectionization for an imported mirror (draft, opt-in). Read-only; returns per-adapter reports + proposalEtag. Nav decline may include nextStep (e.g. mega-menu → edit fragments/header.html). Wait for mirror-vs-editable answer if requiredDecision pending.

full.description: Return the full per-member harvest report (default: compacted for the token budget).

index.description: Blog index content key (default: probe blog.html, posts.html, …).

prefix.description: Member key prefix override, e.g. "post/" (default: detected from index card links).

basePath.description: Index route path override, e.g. "/blog" (default: the index route).

pageSize.description: Explicit page size (default: visible card count).

menu.description: Menu name the nav adapter wires (default "primary").

fragment.description: Chrome fragment name the nav adapter reads (default "header").

refreshProposal.description: Replace an existing UNCONSUMED proposal (otherwise re-analyze 409s proposal_exists).

tools.name: adapt_site_apply
tools.description: Apply the adapt proposal (draft): wire nav into the menu store and/or rewrite the blog index to a live <dotsy-collection>. One undo covers the whole apply; a second apply is refused until adapt_site_revert (or force). Queued applies are polled to completion.

ifMatch.description: The proposal etag from analyze (or GET …/adapt/proposal / status).

dryRun.description: Full computation, would-write set + previews, ZERO writes, no undo.

force.description: An undo record from a prior apply exists (409 adapt_undo_exists): defer-discard it — the prior record is dropped only when this apply SUCCEEDS; a partial-failure rollback reinstates it. Prefer adapt revert first.

tools.name: adapt_site_revert
tools.description: Atomically restore everything the last adapt_site_apply wrote (fragments, the menu doc when the op touched it, index, member configs, routes).

tools.name: get_adapt_status
tools.description: Read adapt state: proposal summary + proposalEtag (+ applied/consumed flag), undo-record presence, active or queued job progress. Use to resume in a fresh session.

tools.name: list_content
tools.description: List content keys (HTML/md); not assets — use list_assets. Defaults to 50 keys per page: raise limit (max 1000) or pass cursor (nextCursor). Per-row `size`/`missing` are measured only on pages of ≤100 rows; past that they're ABSENT (never `null`) unless you pass withSize:true (one storage read per row). Only `size: null` + `missing: true` means the page's bytes are gone.

cursor.description: Resume from a prior response's nextCursor.

withSize.description: Force size/missing measurement on a page bigger than 100 rows (costs one storage read per returned row). Default false — rows in a ≤100-row page are measured either way.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: get_content
tools.description: Read ONE content key (selector = region; published=true = live; over 40KB needs a selector or dotsy pull). Many pages' title/description/h1: list_pages facts:'page'.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: put_content
tools.description: Stage one content key. Body ≤60KB. Larger pages: stage_content_chunk + apply_changeset bodyStaging, dotsy push, or PUT content-raw. Edits to an existing large page: batch_patch_content.

key.description: Content key: a page (about.html, blog/post.html), a layout (layouts/<name>.html) or a fragment (fragments/<name>.html). A <dotsy-fragment name> tag and a route's layout use the bare name, not the key.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: stage_content_chunk
tools.description: Append one ≤60KB chunk of a large new page. Omit stagingId on seq 0; pass the returned stagingId on later seq. Set finalize:true on the last chunk, then apply_changeset with writes[].bodyStaging.

tools.name: patch_content
tools.description: Edit one content key via ops[] (selector ops or replace-string; wrap/unwrap/move restructure siblings). Stages draft; op shapes in schema.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: batch_patch_content
tools.description: patch_content on multiple keys; all-or-nothing validation. Preferred edit path for pages over 60KB. replace-string value/replace ≤60KB; whole call ≤80KB.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: delete_content
tools.description: Delete content key (tombstone if published). A fragments/* section that pages still place is refused with section_in_use (lists the pages) — detach it or remove it first.

tools.name: rename_content
tools.description: Re-key a page by slug (draft or published static), server-side hash copy. Default deletes static routes; movePath:true repoints the route and rewrites menu refs, redirects and root-relative hrefs in draft HTML (as rename_page), leaving a 301 for a published page (leaveRedirect, default true). Retry-safe: 409 rename_failed rolls back. On fragments/<name>.html it also rewrites every <dotsy-fragment name> reference and hide marker. Then publish_site.

newSlug.description: New filename stem; directory prefix preserved (blog/foo → blog/bar)

movePath.description: false (default): delete routes bound to old key. true: move static route path to match slug.

leaveRedirect.description: With movePath:true on an already-published page, leave a 301 at the old path (default true). false removes the old path outright — old links break. No effect when movePath is false, or on a page that was never published.

tools.name: put_post
tools.description: Stage a blog post via structured meta+body (?format=post). Key e.g. blog/my-post.html. Declared membership: meta.collections; schedule: meta.visibleAt; SEO title override: meta.seoTitle (card always shows meta.title); custom fields: meta.custom (typed per collection by get_collection_schema; the response's fieldWarnings flag values that don't fit — soft, never blocking).

title.description: Post title — shown on the blog card/listing and used as the <title> unless seoTitle overrides it.

seoTitle.description: SEO override for the <title>/og:title tags only. The blog card and listing always show `title`; empty or absent inherits `title`.

tools.name: inspect_collection
tools.description: Collection state — count, server.mode, sample entries, tag (membershipKind, match=) when discovered, name, noun, URL pattern, layout, where listed, post fields used. Pass status/q/cursor/limit (any one, even empty) for a full items[] page instead: draft = never published; a published post with unpublished edits is published with hasChanges:true, showing its staged title/date/tags/author; scheduled = future visibleAt. Drafts come from staged content, published/scheduled from the index. limit defaults to 50 (1-200).

prefix.description: Collection id or prefix, e.g. "posts" or "blog/" — use the key exactly as list_collections returned it.

status.description: Filter items[] by status (see the tool description for what each means). Providing this (or q/cursor/limit) is what makes the response include items[].

cursor.description: Resume from a prior response's nextCursor.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Collections on the site — name, noun, item count (or 'not published yet'), URL pattern, and whether any member is staged. Includes a collection only a draft page lists. Returns a bare array (not wrapped in an object) — pass each row's key verbatim to inspect_collection/update_collection.

tools.name: update_collection
tools.description: Rename a collection's display name and/or noun (e.g. the generic 'posts' key shown as 'Recipes' / 'recipe') — cosmetic only, stored separately from the tag that defines membership; doesn't need publish. Provide at least one of name/noun. null (or "") resets that field back to its derived default — different from omitting it, which leaves the current value alone.

key.description: Collection key exactly as list_collections returned it, e.g. "posts" or "blog/" (a hand-typed key may 404 or get silently normalized).

name.description: Display name (≤80 chars). null resets to the derived name.

noun.description: Singular noun for one item, e.g. "post" (≤40 chars). null resets to the derived noun.

tools.name: new_post_template
tools.description: Read-only scaffold for a new post — suggested key/path, membership meta, blank or duplicate body. Then put_post (+ optional put_route).

collection.description: Collection id or prefix, e.g. "posts" or "blog/"

templateKey.description: Exemplar content key; default = most recent member

tools.name: get_collection_schema
tools.description: Read the site's collection field definitions (`_data/collections.json`, draft view): { schema: { v: 1, collections: { "<key>": { fields[], settings? } } }, hash }. hash is null when no schema exists yet — pass it as put_collection_schema ifMatch. 409 collection_schema_invalid { hash, issues } means the stored file is broken: fix it with put_collection_schema using that hash.

tools.name: put_collection_schema
tools.description: Replace the whole field schema (draft; publish makes it live). Edit get_collection_schema's output; keys as list_collections gives them ("blog/" or an id). Field: { key, type, label?, help?, required?, unique?, inCard?, default? } — type text (multiline, minLength, maxLength) | number (min, max, integer) | boolean | option (options[] required) | multiOption (options[] required, max) | link | email | phone | color. Keys: letter then letters/digits/_ (≤40), not a built-in post field (author: text, or a reference to authors/), not secret-looking. ≤60 fields per collection. settings.defaultSort: date:desc|date:asc|title:asc|slug:asc. Removing a collection drops its definitions (post values stay). Values go in put_post meta.custom. 400 invalid_collection_schema lists issues; 409 = stale ifMatch.

ifMatch.description: hash from get_collection_schema (stale → 409 conflict). null = the schema must not exist yet. Omit to write unconditionally.

tools.name: set_item_status
tools.description: Change a roadmap/board item status (stamps dates; on release drafts the changelog post and links both ways). Never hand-edit *At, daysToRelease, or votes.

status.description: One of the board states from get_collection_schema.

at.description: ISO date for the status stamp (backfill).

reply.description: Decline reply when moving to an archived state.

draftChangelog.description: Default true when the board defines a changelog collection.

publish.description: Publish the touched keys after staging.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: List board items with status, stamp fields, and baked vote counts (draft overlay included). Live vote totals: site host GET /__dotsy/votes.

tools.name: list_votes
tools.description: List voters on one board item (voter id + source only — no email).

tools.name: remove_votes
tools.description: Remove one voter's vote and drop their release subscription for that item.

tools.name: list_suggestions
tools.description: List form suggestions to moderate (duplicate hints); `about` filters by tool id.

tools.name: moderate_suggestion
tools.description: Decide one form suggestion from list_suggestions: approve (new draft board item; stages content, does not publish), merge (into an existing board item, subscribes the voter/email) or decline.

itemKey.description: merge: the existing board item's key (required).

reason.description: decline: note kept with the suggestion.

tools.name: add_idea
tools.description: Add an idea from outside the site (draft board item or inbox suggestion). Idempotent on externalRef.

tools.name: list_ideas
tools.description: Search draft/published board items and open suggestions by title token overlap.

tools.name: infer_collection_schema
tools.description: Suggest fields for one collection from a sample of its items' meta.custom values (published data, else drafts) — writes nothing. Returns { sampled, suggestions: [{ field: { key, type, options? }, count, samples, defined }], skipped }. Review, then add the ones you want via put_collection_schema.

collection.description: Collection key exactly as list_collections returned it, e.g. "blog/" or "posts".

tools.name: reindex_collection
tools.description: Build/finish collection indexes after publish returns collectionDataPending or collectionSqlPending.

tools.name: preview_page
tools.description: Verify-only composed HTML check of one page; home preview may include requiredDecision — ask mirror vs editable before structure_*. Many pages' head facts: list_pages facts:'page'.

contains.description: Assert substrings present in composed HTML.

notContains.description: Assert absent — e.g. `<dotsy-` for unresolved template tags.

variant.description: A/B variant arm to compose (e.g. "b") — same as ?dotsy-variant= on the public URL.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: verify_page
tools.description: Pre-publish lint (tags, assets, layout, SEO, speed and accessibility). Summary first: health issues grouped by code, each with fix:{tool,args,fill?} — supply the fill args, then call. health.summary counts are whole-site (groups/codes filter only issues and assets). Pair with preview_page — see get_skill('verify').

paths.description: Routes to check; omit to verify every route on the site.

groups.description: Only these groups: speed = perf_*, a11y = a11y_*, links = link_* + content_*. Omit for all.

codes.description: Only these health codes, e.g. perf_image_heavy.

detail.description: summary (default): grouped by code, clean pages counted. full: per-page lists.

tools.name: preflight_site
tools.description: Plan check before publish or large build (counts, plan page cap, seo suggestions; imports: form_unwired advisory, webflow_store blocking). When ok is false, blocking lists the failed suggestion codes. Read-only.

requiredRoutes.description: How many routes you plan to add

requiredAssets.description: How many assets you plan to upload

tools.name: start_edit_session
tools.description: Open a draft session. Returns preview/edit URLs for the person (see linkGuidance). draftEditorUrl only when the site gives AI agents Full access. path defaults to '/'.

tools.name: get_site_outline
tools.description: Site shape: every layout and shared section (`sections`: fragments/* by name, with page count, file exists, staged-change flag), whether a layout is missing, redirects count, menus grouped by where they show, and collections with their page placements, without listing every page. Indexing mirrors list_pages (a fresh import may still be indexing).

tools.name: share_section
tools.description: Share a repeated block, or move/hide a shared section. No arguments: lists blocks on 3+ pages (likeSection: matches a shared one). sourceKey + selector (selectors: a sibling run): dry run lists pages; dryRun:false shares it. name + suggestionId: put it on a suggestion's pages (after = through while remaining > 0). name + scope/hide/show: move to/from every page, or hide/show per page. too_many_pages: share with keys, again by the same name from a page with a copy; then name + scope every_page + keys (max-1 a call). Draft only (publish_site; undo: revert_change).

sourceKey.description: Content key of the page the element is on, e.g. 'about.html'.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element in the page's stored HTML (the editor's selector, or one checked with get_content?selector=). It must match exactly one element.

ifMatch.description: The page's content hash (analyze's sourceEtag). If the page changed since, nothing is written.

name.description: New name (default: proposed), or the existing section to re-place or use.

scope.description: where_found: each page that has it gets a reference. every_page: one slot in the layout, at the top or bottom of the page content; pages listed in `hide` don't show it.

keys.description: Pages with an exact copy to share it on (analyze's matches.keys). Omit for every exact copy. The source page is always included.

similar.description: Pages with a similar copy (analyze's similar.keys) that take the shared version, losing their own wording. Default none.

hide.description: every_page: pages to keep it off (they keep their copy). Send with the first move, never later.

show.description: Pages that should show it again (removes their marker).

suggestionId.description: With name = likeSection: use that section on its pages.

dryRun.description: Default true: report what would change and write nothing. false: stage the change as a draft (publish_site makes it live).

selectors.description: Instead of selector: a run of adjacent siblings in page order (each matches one element); one section, one wrapper.

wrapTag.description: With selectors: the wrapper. Default footer when the run ends the page content, else section.

keepLayout.description: With selectors: wrapper gets style="display:contents" so a flex/grid parent lays the run out as before. Default true.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: detach_section
tools.description: Give one page its own copy of a shared section; every other page keeps the shared one. A draft — publish_site to go live. A section the layout places is hidden on that page instead (share_section name + hide).

name.description: Section name. Its file is fragments/<name>.html, placed with <dotsy-fragment name="<name>">.

pageKey.description: Content key of the page that gets its own copy, e.g. 'pricing.html'.

ifMatch.description: The page's content hash. If the page changed since, nothing is written.

dryRun.description: Default true: report what would change and write nothing. false: stage the change as a draft (publish_site makes it live).

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Get one route by path (home is '/').

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: put_route
tools.description: Create/replace route; contentKey derived from path if omitted. On a field that accepts null (contentKey, redirectTo, redirectStatus, preserveQuery), sending null clears it back to its default.

contentKey.description: Explicit content key (default: path-derived). null restores the default (undoes a prior set on PATCH).

layout.description: Layout NAME, bare ("default" for layouts/default.html), not the file key. Must already exist (400 layout_not_found). null removes it.

redirectTo.description: Root-relative redirect target (/…). Required when purpose is "redirect"; null clears it once purpose is no longer "redirect".

redirectStatus.description: 301 permanent / 302 or 308 temporary (default 301 on a redirect). null clears an explicit override.

preserveQuery.description: Append the visitor's query string to the redirect target (default true on a redirect). null clears the override.

id.description: Stable experiment slug — cookie namespace; unique per site forever.
Variant arm id — default "a" / "b" on create.

goalId.description: Optional dotsy conversion goal; omit when tracking in external analytics.

changeNote.description: One line on what the variant changes (0.56e M2); kept so route PATCH round-trips don't strip it.

handsOff.description: Hands-off mode (0.56e M4): the daily sweep may auto-promote a ≥95% winner or auto-end keep-A after 30 days. Prefer start_test; kept so route PATCH round-trips don't strip it.

noindex.description: Exclude from sitemap/RSS; inject noindex meta (0.69).

lang.description: Page language, e.g. "es", "pt-BR". null clears (folder or main language applies).

translationKey.description: Pages sharing a key are translations of each other. null clears.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: patch_route
tools.description: Partial route update (only sent fields change; an OMITTED field is left alone). On a nullable field (contentKey, redirectTo, redirectStatus, preserveQuery), null CLEARS it to its default — unlike omitting it. To set redirectTo/redirectStatus, send purpose: "redirect" in the SAME call (only what's sent is checked, even on an existing redirect) or it 400s invalid_body.

contentKey.description: Explicit content key (default: path-derived). null restores the default (undoes a prior set on PATCH).

layout.description: Layout NAME, bare ("default" for layouts/default.html), not the file key. Must already exist (400 layout_not_found). null removes it.

redirectTo.description: Root-relative redirect target (/…). Required when purpose is "redirect"; null clears it once purpose is no longer "redirect".

redirectStatus.description: 301 permanent / 302 or 308 temporary (default 301 on a redirect). null clears an explicit override.

preserveQuery.description: Append the visitor's query string to the redirect target (default true on a redirect). null clears the override.

id.description: Stable experiment slug — cookie namespace; unique per site forever.
Variant arm id — default "a" / "b" on create.

goalId.description: Optional dotsy conversion goal; omit when tracking in external analytics.

changeNote.description: One line on what the variant changes (0.56e M2); kept so route PATCH round-trips don't strip it.

handsOff.description: Hands-off mode (0.56e M4): the daily sweep may auto-promote a ≥95% winner or auto-end keep-A after 30 days. Prefer start_test; kept so route PATCH round-trips don't strip it.

noindex.description: Exclude from sitemap/RSS; inject noindex meta (0.69).

lang.description: Page language, e.g. "es", "pt-BR". null clears (folder or main language applies).

translationKey.description: Pages sharing a key are translations of each other. null clears.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: rename_page
tools.description: Change a page's URL: moves route `from` to `to`. Menu links and redirects to the old path retarget; a 301 stays at the old path (leaveRedirect). Root-relative and {slug}.dotsy.site hrefs in draft HTML are rewritten (linksRewritten; linksRewriteTruncated past 100 keys, 500 with full search). Retry-safe. rename_experiment_running: end the A/B test first; rename_target_exists is a 200 if `to` already serves it. Then publish_site.

leaveRedirect.description: Leave a 301 from the old path to the new one (default true). false removes the old path outright — old links break.

tools.name: delete_route
tools.description: Remove a route by path.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: List site conversion goals (pageview paths and form submits). Required before start_test.

tools.name: put_goals
tools.description: Create or replace all site conversion goals (≤50). Required before start_test when no goal exists.

pathPattern.description: Match path exactly or prefix with trailing * (e.g. "/thanks" or "/blog/*").

tools.name: estimate_test
tools.description: Estimate days to reach promote readiness for a page (traffic baseline). Read-only.

tools.name: start_test
tools.description: Start a same-URL A/B test (draft or live source). Rules → get_skill('verify') § A/B.

changeNote.description: One line on what the variant changes, shown on the test card (≤120 chars).

handsOff.description: Hands-off mode (0.56e M4): dotsy finishes the test WITHOUT further user instruction — the LIVE SITE may change later on its own (a ≥95% winner is auto-promoted, old page kept as a draft; or after 30 days with no clear winner the test auto-ends keeping the control). Only set when the user explicitly asked for hands-off / auto-finish.

tools.name: promote_experiment
tools.description: Promote a winning A/B variant to live — explicit user instruction only; see get_skill('verify') § A/B.

tools.name: delete_draft_test
tools.description: Remove a draft A/B test (releases variant bodies; does not publish).

tools.name: set_experiment_note
tools.description: Record what was learned from an ended A/B test (≤500 chars; null clears).

note.description: The learning, in plain words (≤500 chars, multiline ok) — null clears it.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Read a menu's draft items and etag; menu rules → get_skill('nav').

tools.name: put_menu_item
tools.description: Partial upsert one menu item: send only the fields to change; omitted fields keep their stored value and parent: null moves it to the top level. data/attrs merge per key (data: {desc} keeps data.icon; a null value removes that key). A new id needs label, kind and ref (parent defaults to null, sort to the end) and dedupes by (menu, ref). An existing id updates that item. Remove html/childTemplate via put_menu_doc.

tools.name: delete_menu_item
tools.description: Remove one item from a menu (page stays live).

tools.name: reorder_menu
tools.description: Set final menu order. Pass ifMatch from get_menu; stale → 409 with current items.

tools.name: get_menu_doc
tools.description: Read the whole menu doc (all menus + shell/template), etag for put_menu_doc, and issues (by item id) — page_not_routable, page_missing, page_dead_link, page_is_redirect — computed from the draft routes, so a link that won't show or leads nowhere shows up before publish.

source.description: Which doc to read. Default draft.

tools.name: put_menu_doc
tools.description: Replace the whole menu doc (ifMatch from get_menu_doc required). Each item may omit menu — the enclosing menu key in doc is used.

ifMatch.description: Whole-doc etag from get_menu_doc. Required (sent as If-Match).

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: CMS uploads under assets/ only — not mirrored clone CDN (get_site mirroredAssets or import warmJob). Not content — use list_content. Live in the editor and preview at once; on the live site after the next publish.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Read one asset (metadata + base64 + stored sha256). sha256 is the stored blob; may differ from upload bodySha256 when IMAGES re-encodes rasters. Live in the editor and preview at once; on the live site after the next publish.

key.description: Path after /assets/ on the site — e.g. photos/hero.webp or style.css. Do not prefix with assets/ or /. Uploaded files are live in the editor and draft preview at once; the published site picks them up at the next publish.

tools.name: bulk_put_assets
tools.description: Upload 1–200 CMS assets; key = path after /assets/, or sitePath for an exact URL path (e.g. /ads.txt). Each item: exactly one of bodyBase64, bodyText (plain text for .css/.js/.mjs/.json/.svg/.txt/.xml only, not .html), or importFromUrl. Up to 5 MB per asset (10 MB paid); the 60KB page limit doesn't apply. Big files: importFromUrl or dotsy push. Optional bodySha256 checks sent bytes; response sha256 = stored bytes. JPEG/PNG/static GIF become WebP (key photo.webp; /assets/photo.jpg still serves it): use the response key in CSS/JS; optimize:false keeps your bytes; animated GIFs kept. Live in editor/preview at once; live site after next publish.

key.description: Path after /assets/ on the site — e.g. photos/hero.webp or style.css. Do not prefix with assets/ or /. Uploaded files are live in the editor and draft preview at once; the published site picks them up at the next publish.

sitePath.description: Store at this exact site path instead of /assets/{key} — e.g. /.well-known/security.txt, /ads.txt, /favicon.ico. Send key OR sitePath.

bodySha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the submitted upload bytes (decoded bodyBase64 or raw PUT body). Mismatch returns body_sha256_mismatch before any write. Response/get_asset sha256 is the stored blob (WebP after IMAGES optimization for rasters; unchanged for JS/CSS/SVG).

optimize.description: Default true: a JPEG, PNG or static GIF is re-encoded to WebP (key photo.jpg is stored as photo.webp, and /assets/photo.jpg still serves it). false stores the bytes exactly as sent, at the key given. Animated GIFs are always kept as sent.

tools.name: delete_asset
tools.description: Delete a static asset by key. The editor and draft preview drop it at once; the published site drops it at the next publish.

key.description: Path after /assets/ on the site — e.g. photos/hero.webp or style.css. Do not prefix with assets/ or /. Uploaded files are live in the editor and draft preview at once; the published site picks them up at the next publish.

tools.name: optimize_assets
tools.description: Shrink heavy images in place: JPEG/PNG/still GIF → WebP at the same address, so no HTML changes. keys = site paths from verify_page health.assets[].ref — /assets/… or clone paths like /wp-content/… (1–50 per call). Skips animated, already-small and non-images (`skipped`); idempotent. The original is kept under .originals (never served). Spends the daily image budget like an upload — dryRun:true reports the saving without spending it. The draft serves the smaller file at once; live after you publish (some imported files sooner).

keys.description: Site paths of the images, e.g. /assets/hero.jpg or /wp-content/uploads/photo.png.

dryRun.description: Report before/after sizes only; writes nothing and spends no budget.

tools.name: speed_compare
tools.description: Old site vs dotsy site, five Lighthouse categories. get (default): latest result; run: start a test (minutes); history: last 20 results (`id`: one + state; `compareTo`: changes vs another); `auto` (+`on`): daily check after publish; share: public page + image of the latest LIVE result; unshare: take it down; fix: apply ticked fixes (or `fixes`: shrink, eager_first_image, video_on_tap, load_later; `scripts` [{ref, load}]) to the DRAFT, re-test. engine psi = Google PageSpeed Insights, lh = dotsy speed test (never call it PageSpeed). Quote only scores it returns.

compareTo.description: With action:'history' and id: another result id.

tools.name: translate_page
tools.description: Stage draft copies of pages in another language: copied as is, language set, linked to the original as a translation (menus not copied). Then translate the bodies, write them in one apply_changeset, and publish_site. Target path = language folder + source path unless an item sets `path`; an existing path is left untouched.

lang.description: Language of the new pages, e.g. de or pt-BR.

paths.description: Source paths, or {from, path} to choose the new path.

from.description: Copy from this translation's path instead of the main-language page.

tools.name: start_site
tools.description: Start one draft site with no dotsy account. Returns slug + guestToken — pass guestToken on every later tool call until claim_site.

tools.name: claim_site
tools.description: Move the guest draft onto your signed-in dotsy account. Requires OAuth Connect; pass the guestToken from start_site.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: Paige build skills (id + whenToUse). Pull get_skill on demand — do not duplicate in tool text.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Skill body + optional questions[]. Accepts an id OR a synonym (e.g. 'list', 'menu') — resolves aliases and suggests near-misses. Start with intake when ambiguous.

id.description: Skill id or synonym from list_skills, e.g. intake, clone, list, menu

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Optional mid-session feedback (required feedback rides with publish_site).

tools.name: get_activity
tools.description: List site activity or fetch one change diff (pass id). Filters: who, state, actor (me), since, until, limit≤20. Notes from context are visible to everyone on the site — no secrets.

state.description: needs_review = agent drafts awaiting a person's publish.

key.description: Content key when id is set (default first key in the event).

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List the site's published versions, newest first (who, when, pages, live, restorable). Use before restore_version.

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Bring an earlier published version back as unpublished changes (page content only — routes, menus, images and settings stay). version: a number from list_versions, or "previous". dryRun: show what would change. Then review and publish_site, or discard_drafts to undo; publish:true makes it live at once.

version.description: A version from list_versions, or "previous" (the one before live).

dryRun.description: Only list what would change; writes nothing.

keys.description: Restore only these content keys (single-page restore: CORE workspaces). Default: the whole version.

removeAdded.description: Remove pages added since the version. Default true.

replaceDrafts.description: Replace unpublished changes on the pages the restore touches. Without it such a restore answers 409 drafts_pending.

publish.description: Publish exactly the restored pages at once (live-mode sites). Default false: they stay unpublished changes.

tools.name: undo_publish
tools.description: Take back the last publish at once: restores the previous version of the pages it changed and publishes them; the undone changes stay as unpublished changes (`restaged`). On a live-mode site nothing is kept: the answer has `redo.version` — restore_version with it and publish: true brings it back. publishVersion = what publish_site returned. not_latest if another publish landed since. If its publish fails, the undo stays unpublished — publish_site finishes it.

publishVersion.description: The version the publish to undo returned.

tools.name: revert_change
tools.description: Undo one activity event by staging the prior version as draft only — call publish_site to go live. Respects AI access.

keys.description: Undo only these keys of the change. Default: every key.

reason.description: Why — shown next to 'Reverted by …'. Visible to everyone on the site.

guestToken.description: pgg_ guest token; omit when signed in.

tools.name: get_account_context
tools.description: Account, user, memberships[]. Pass workspace on writes when memberships.length > 1.

workspace.description: Workspace org id or slug (multi-workspace only; omit if one workspace).

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Report a dotsy bug, or ask a support question (kind question — AI answer from the help centre). Bugs attach recent errors and return a ticket id.

site.description: Site it happened on. Omit for an account-level issue. Stored as about.site; the ticket is filed in dotsy's inbox.

kind.description: bug (default) files a ticket. question runs the help-centre AI turn (use actual as the question text).

reportedBy.description: user = the human asked you to report it.

attachments.description: Ids from POST /api/v1/support/attachments. No file bytes.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Your dotsy bug reports. Omit id for the list; pass id for one ticket and its public replies.

id.description: Omit for your list; pass a ticket id for one report and its replies.

tools.name: reply_to_report
tools.description: Add information or answer dotsy's question on your own report.

attachments.description: Ids from POST /api/v1/support/attachments. No file bytes.

tools.name: get_popups
tools.description: Read popups. No id: the popups (status, draft vs published, 7-day views and conversion), site-wide rules, site look and plan limit. id: one popup (config, body, css, fill-ins, warnings). view templates: the template catalog. view stats + id: views, closes, conversions by day (range 7d/30d/90d; available:false = no data store yet). preview + id: a draft link and whether it would show.

preview.description: With id: draft preview url + trace.

previewAs.description: What-if for preview: {path, device: desktop|tablet|mobile, visitor: new|returning, now: ISO time, state: {closedDaysAgo, convertedDaysAgo, views, viewsThisVisit}}.

tools.name: put_popup
tools.description: Create or edit a popup: modal, slide-in, fullscreen, or an announcement bar (show.as barTop/barBottom), e.g. a newsletter box; or send settings / look to change the site-wide popup rules / look. One target per call. Staged: live at publish_site. New: template + fill (get_popups view templates), or name + show.as + where.include + body. Edit: send only what changes; config objects merge, null removes an optional key, arrays replace. id + status live|paused alone starts or stops it; add publish:true to apply that status now (use for a stop). get_skill('popups') first.

id.description: Edit this popup, or create with this id. Omit to create.

template.description: Create from this template id (get_popups view templates). Starts paused.

fill.description: Template fill-ins by name, e.g. {headline, text, buttonLink, image:{src,alt}}. Works on an existing popup too.

body.description: Full body HTML (replaces it). No <script> or on*=.

css.description: The popup's own CSS, unprefixed (dotsy scopes it). "" clears.

status.description: Draft status; live only after publish_site.

show.description: {as: modal|slideIn|fullscreen|barTop|barBottom, position, overlay, style, animation, closeButton, pushContent, closeOnOverlay, closeOnEsc, scrollLock, tablet, phone}

when.description: {any:[{delay:secs}|{scroll:%}|{exit:{sensitivity}}|{click:selector}]}: opens on the first; [] = only from a link or JS.

where.description: {include:[paths, one trailing * allowed], exclude:[paths]}; exclude wins.

publish.description: With id + status only: publish that status now.

settings.description: Site-wide rules, not a popup: {slots:{overlay 0-3, barTop 0-1, barBottom 0-1} shown at once, maxPerVisit 1-10, mobileGuard: hold full-screen popups on phones}.

look.description: The site look popups wear, not a popup: {vars:{font, headingFont, text, heading, bg, link, accent, accentText, radius, shadow, fieldBorder, fieldBg, fieldRadius}, button:{classes, sample}|null, read:{page} re-reads the site, reset}.

tools.name: delete_popup
tools.description: Delete a popup (body and settings). Staged: it leaves the live site at the next publish_site.

tools.name: add_custom_domain
tools.description: Connect apex and/or www on a paid plan; starts a DNS connect session.

domain.description: Bare domain when hosts omitted (apex + www); a subdomain connects as-is.

tools.name: get_custom_domain_connect
tools.description: Current connect session and nextAction (browser URL or manual DNS guide).

sessionId.description: Connect session id; omit to resume.

tools.name: reapply_custom_domain_oauth
tools.description: Re-apply DNS with stored Cloudflare OAuth grant (no browser).

tools.name: refresh_custom_domain
tools.description: Poll one hostname until DNS/cert propagates.

tools.name: wait_for_custom_domain
tools.description: Poll one hostname until it is connected or the timeout is reached.

host.description: Hostname to wait for, e.g. www.example.com

tools.name: set_primary_custom_domain
tools.description: Set the canonical host (301 target).

tools.name: list_custom_domains
tools.description: List all custom hostnames and connection status for the site. A connected bare domain with redirectorState "attention" is NOT redirecting (see `attention`).

tools.name: set_up_bare_domain
tools.description: Set up an EXISTING bare domain (example.com) that doesn't open the site (www works). Refuses if dotsy already serves it; deletes nothing. domain.dnsRecords: (1) _acme-challenge CNAME (apex_cert); (2) once issueState is issued, replace the old @ records (action delete) with the A/AAAA rows. cancel:true (while canCancelSetUp) restores everything; 409 too_late_to_stop once @ points at dotsy. Other 409: www_not_connected, already_serving, not_supported, not_needed. 503: retry.

cancel.description: Stop a set-up that has not gone live and restore the previous state exactly

tools.name: remove_custom_domain
tools.description: Remove one custom hostname from the site.

tools.name: list_form_submissions
tools.description: List form submissions (metadata + bounded field preview — not full PII). Works on kv and do-sqlite backends.

form.description: Form id from dotsy-config, e.g. contact

tools.name: form_recipients
tools.description: Who a site's forms may email. A form's `to` address gets submissions only when it is a verified site member or confirmed a one-click link we email it (no account needed). action: `list` (confirmed + waiting addresses), `status` (one address: member | confirmed | pending | expired | unconfirmed), `request` (email the confirm link; 7 days, single use; max 3 per address, 20 per site and 50 per account a day), `revoke` (stop form emails to a confirmed address). A publish already sends the link once when a form emails an unconfirmed address. Never ask the user for the link — it goes to that inbox only.

email.description: The address (required for status, request, revoke)

tools.name: get_form_submission
tools.description: Read one form submission with the full field payload (explicit PII access — use only when needed).

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: Account notification inbox (Needs you · Updates). Summary-first: tab counts plus compact rows with nextAction (MCP tool or dashboard URL). OAuth person only — not API keys.

tab.description: Tab filter (default: both classes in one list).

scope.description: Scope filter (default all workspaces you belong to).

slug.description: Site slug — required when scope is site.

tools.name: mark_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark Update notifications read (ids or all). Needs-you Actions refuse with 422 action_not_markable — fix the cause (it clears itself); only the person can dismiss them in the dashboard.

all.description: Mark every Update read across all your workspaces.

tools.name: list_my_sites
tools.description: List your dotsy sites. Renders a site-picker for humans; agent reads structuredContent. Use to choose a site — not for editing content (use edit_page) or verify-only checks (use preview_page). Defaults to your active workspace; pass workspace (org id or slug from get_account_context memberships) to list another workspace's sites without switching the dashboard session.

workspace.description: Workspace org id or slug (multi-workspace only; omit if one workspace).

status.description: Dashboard section, newest first; page with limit + cursor.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List pages on a site — route settings (path/title/navLabel/purpose) by default, one row per route. Renders a page-picker for humans (redirect and worker routes left out there — nothing to open in edit_page); agent reads structuredContent. Use after picking a site — not for editing (use edit_page) or verify-only checks (use preview_page). Pass view:'pages' to group by layout instead — filters, what each page places, indexing progress; use it for 'what pages use this layout' or 'is this page indexed yet'. Add facts for every page's title/description/h1/canonical/words/links in one call. Paginated — pass cursor (from nextCursor) for more; partial:true means this page is a window, not the full route set.

limit.description: Pages per page (server default applies when omitted).

cursor.description: Resume from a prior response's nextCursor.

view.description: pages: group by layout (enables layout/noLayout/q/facts, adds structure + indexing). Omit for per-route rows.

layout.description: Only with view:'pages'. Layout file key (layouts/store.html or bare 'store'). Exclusive with noLayout.

noLayout.description: Only with view:'pages'. Pages with no layout. Exclusive with layout.

q.description: Only with view:'pages'. Case-insensitive substring match on path or title.

facts.description: Only with view:'pages'. seo: description + lengths, stored scan (100/call; just-written pages may lag). page: live read, adds h1, canonical, words, links, assets (25/call). Use cursor.

tools.name: edit_page
tools.description: Open the interactive page canvas to change content: the user clicks an element, then you call patch_content. Use when the intent is editing — not for verify-only checks (use preview_page).

stage.description: Preview stage. Default draft; published is planned but not supported yet.

tools.name: get_site_build_progress
tools.description: Read-only build progress view (import, structure/adapt jobs). structuredContent.forHumans holds the headline and progress. import_site_from_url points here when its job is still running; get_site has the full state.
